annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation applies to providers of AI systems (whether established in the Union or a third country) and to deployers of AI systems established in the Union, as well as other operators, Union institutions and bodies acting as providers or deployers.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the rules established by this Regulation should apply to providers of AI systems in a non-discriminatory manner, irrespective of whether they are established within the Union or in a third country, and to deployers of AI systems established within the Union.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: REGULATION (EU) 2024/… OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence
